response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC, original_language_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Ties in film count are broken by original_language_id ascending (NULL group first among ties), since the request doesn't specify a tiebreaker. The request's 'any missing counts last' is read as applying to missing values in the sort key, and film counts are never missing, so it has no effect here.
The average is computed per film as rental_rate / rental_duration and then averaged across the group's films. It is not computed as AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration).
